note: County make-up for the page: ACS 2020-24 (Census Reporter), NCHS 2023 place types (1 big city .. 6 rural), density per sq mi of land (TIGER 2023), 2020 US Religion Census shares of residents (traditions grouped approximately), presidential D and R votes 2016/2020/2024 (tonmcg). rural: share of residents in rural areas, 2010 census (MEDSL), as the model uses. Alaska (02000) and Connecticut (09000) are one statewide unit each: their results do not come by county (Alaska by state house district, Connecticut by town, with 2016-20 on its old counties and 2024 on its planning regions); median income there is the state ACS figure. DC 2024: its wards summed. cvap: citizens of voting age, ACS 2020-24 5-year table B29001 (B29001001), via the Census Reporter API, 31 Oct 2026; Alaska and Connecticut summed over their boroughs / planning regions.
